entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-10-07
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Renaming type parameter as type argument of operator-returned generic type fails #80580
  • Prefer using the is false pattern matching over inverting a boolean expression #80579
  • Surface project extension load failures #80576

Closed

  • CS8659 must be reported on partial properties #80509
    Next
  • Add public API implementation for getting await info from await using and await foreach #80409
    18.0

PullRequests

Created

  • Downgrade Microsoft.Build.Framework so we can publish packages #80584
  • Avoid double-delete when racing on deleted directory #80582
    Area-Analyzers
  • Fbp live directive diagnostics #80575
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • Update insertionTitlePrefix for dev18 #80583
  • Add support for `with(...)` elements in collection expressions. #80495
    Needs API Review, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Move Watch EA to a separate assembly Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.ExternalAccess.HotReload #80556
    Area-IDE, Needs API Review, VSCode, Next
  • Enable long paths for Windows DartLab CI #80581
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Ensure that CS8659 is reported on partial properties #80573
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Fix a wrong relative link in a doc #80567
    Documentation, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80578
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Update main configs after VS snap #80523
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Add followup async public apis #80455
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Runtime Async, Next

Updated

  • WIP: Add support for with(...) elements in collection expressions (2). #80554
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review
  • WIP: with-element and collection builders #80568
  • Start of enabling runtime async tests #80362
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix LSP `GetTextDocumentAsync` returning different document from request context #80535
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Basic github source linking for standalone language server #80566
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Improve diagnostic quality for less accessible base type argument #80483
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Initial spike for file-based programs editor features #80410
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Use built-in inline array types when possible #80557
    Area-Compilers
  • Extend `ToArray` optimization when targeting read-only collection types #80104
    Area-Compilers, Community, Code Gen Quality
